I’m so thrilled to announce that we’re bringing our Cardboard Wars Film and other new stories to Disney! I fell in love with filmmaking and storytelling as a young kid, grabbing my parents’ home video camera and teaching myself to edit. A lot of my early homemade films were inspired by the Disney movies and the behind-the-scenes footage they would show in the DVD featurettes. There was always a sense of magic I would see on the screen, and so I’m thrilled to be working with Disney to continue that magic of filmmaking for the next generation of storytellers.
